title: Append a safe new item
summary: You can create an element and set its text before adding it to a list.
introduction: You can create an element and set its text before adding it to a list. Your task: Append another title using a new li.
learningObjectives: Append another title using a new li.
Explain the example for append a safe new item

blocks.text: You can create an element and set its text before adding it to a list. This avoids building HTML from untrusted text.
Use a local HTML page that loads jQuery 3.7 before these scripts. Examples need that library; the plain playground does not include it. Put the script after the example markup.
Read the code step by step

items: `$("<li>")` creates a new list item rather than selecting an old one.
The text method supplies safe words, and append puts the item inside the existing list.

blocks.text: The list gains one book item.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not join raw user text into an HTML string. Use text on the created element.
